item.group_name: Short video from a picture or text
item.title: Soft Glowing Phone Wallpaper

turns.text: Make me an 8-second looping video wallpaper for my phone, 9:16. Soft blue and purple glowing ribbons moving slowly on a dark background. Leave the top third mostly dark for the clock. No words or sound, and no jump when it loops.

item.tests: Tests delivery of a genuinely animated seamless portrait wallpaper with a clock-safe composition, not a landscape clip padded into a phone frame.

answer_sheet.Source image: Generate it from scratch; no photo.
answer_sheet.Style and colours: Soft abstract glowing ribbons in blue and purple against a dark background.
answer_sheet.Composition: Keep the top third mostly dark and place most of the ribbons below it so the clock stays readable.
answer_sheet.Duration and motion: 8 seconds, slow flowing motion, and a seamless repeat.
answer_sheet.Text and audio: No words, clock graphic or sound; my phone supplies the clock.

must_haves: The deliverable is an 8-second portrait 9:16 video, with artwork filling the frame rather than a landscape image surrounded by bars.
Soft blue and purple glowing ribbons visibly move slowly against a dark background.
The top third stays mostly dark and uncluttered throughout, with the brightest ribbons concentrated lower down.
Repeated playback has no visible jump, flash or abrupt reset at the loop boundary.
There are no words, clock graphics or other interface elements baked into the video.
The video has no audible sound.

turns.text: Could you make me a looping video wallpaper for my phone with soft blue and purple glowing ribbons moving slowly against a dark background? I’ve been wanting to freshen up my phone because I look at it so often throughout the day. I mean an 8-second video in vertical 9:16, with a slow flowing motion rather than anything abrupt. Please generate it from scratch, not from a photo, and leave the top third mostly dark with most of the ribbons below it so the clock stays readable. I worry a little about wallpapers making my screen feel cluttered. There should be no words, clock graphic, or sound, since my phone supplies the clock, and the repeat should be seamless with no jump when it loops.

dialog.agent:
Should it have sound: music, a voice, or silent?

Should any words appear on it? If so, which, exactly?
dialog.why: It asks the user to choose sound options and specify any on-screen wording, then waits for their input.
dialog.user: Silent, please—no music, voice, or other sound, and no words should appear anywhere. There shouldn’t be a clock graphic either, since my phone supplies the clock. That’s also why I want the top third mostly dark, so the actual clock stays readable.

approvals.name: create_video_from_text

style.prompt: Create an abstract phone video wallpaper from scratch. Vertical 9:16 composition, 8 seconds, silent. Minimalist near-black navy background with only a few soft blue and purple luminous translucent ribbons, delicately glowing with restrained bloom. Most ribbons lie in the lower two thirds, especially the bottom half. Keep the entire top third nearly black, quiet and empty so a phone's own clock remains readable. Spacious negative space, very uncluttered, calming rather than distracting. Locked static camera. Ribbons flow very slowly and smoothly in a gentle periodic undulating motion, no abrupt movement. Design as one seamless looping eight-second cycle: identical ribbon positions, shapes, light levels, and motion direction at the beginning and end, continuous velocity across the repeat boundary. No entrance or exit, no fade in or fade out, no cuts, no camera motion, no flashes, no changing brightness, no particles. No text, letters, numbers, logos, symbols, clock graphics, interface or watermarks. Silent with no music, speech or other sound.
